# 1. Executive Summary

This report presents an overview of retail sales performance using transaction data, business KPIs and revenue trends.

# 2. Load Data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

retail_clean <- readRDS(
  "../data/processed/retail_cleaned.rds"
)
```

# 3. Key Business Performance Indicators

```{r}
total_revenue <- sum(retail_clean$Revenue, na.rm = TRUE)

total_orders <- n_distinct(retail_clean$Invoice)

total_customers <- n_distinct(
  retail_clean$`Customer ID`,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

total_products <- n_distinct(retail_clean$StockCode)

kpi_summary <- data.frame(
  KPI = c(
    "Total Net Revenue",
    "Total Orders",
    "Total Customers",
    "Total Products"
  ),
  Value = c(
    round(total_revenue, 2),
    total_orders,
    total_customers,
    total_products
  )
)

kable(kpi_summary)
```

# 4. Monthly Revenue Analysis

```{r}
monthly_revenue <- retail_clean %>%
  group_by(Year, Month_Number) %>%
  summarise(
    Revenue = sum(Revenue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(monthly_revenue,
       aes(x = Month_Number, y = Revenue)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Revenue Trend",
    x = "Month Number",
    y = "Net Revenue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 5. Top 10 Countries by Revenue

```{r}
top_countries <- retail_clean %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Revenue = sum(Revenue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Revenue)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

kable(top_countries)

ggplot(top_countries,
       aes(x = reorder(Country, Revenue),
           y = Revenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Countries by Revenue",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Net Revenue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 6. Top 10 Products

```{r}
top_products <- retail_clean %>%
  filter(Quantity > 0) %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(
    Quantity_Sold = sum(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Quantity_Sold)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

kable(top_products)
```

# 7. Business Insights

- November recorded the highest monthly revenue.
- The United Kingdom contributed the largest share of revenue.
- Thursday recorded the highest weekday revenue.
- WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS was the top product by quantity sold.

# 8. Conclusion

The analysis provides insights into sales performance, product demand and geographical revenue contribution. These findings can support better business planning and decision-making.

**Data limitation:** The transaction dataset covers December 2009 to December 2011 and is international Online Retail II data. Kerala-specific store and inventory information in this project is simulated separately.
